events.text: Checking the code and running the probes again on a fresh local stack.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create clean worktree and start fresh stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; WT=/tmp/t229-verify-wt; rm -rf $WT; git worktree add --detach $WT origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; cp cloud/.dev.vars $WT/cloud/.dev.vars; ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/node_modules $WT/cloud/node_modules; cd $WT; git log -1 --format=%h; git merge-base --is-ancestor 51c7ee1 HEAD && echo contains-fix; (SIM_PORT=8912 nohup python3 cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py > /tmp/t229-sim.log 2>&1 & echo sim=$!); cd cloud; (nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8911 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8912 --persist-to /tmp/t229-persist > /tmp/t229-wr.log 2>&1 & ech

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply local migrations, check stack up
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t229-verify-wt/cloud; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to /tmp/t229-persist 2>&1 | tail -2; tail -3 /tmp/t229-wr.log; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8911/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8912/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for wrangler dev to come up
events.input: $ for i in $(seq 1 20); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8911/); [ "$c" != "000" ] && break; perl -e 'select(undef,undef,undef,3)'; done; echo $c; grep -i "error\|ready" /tmp/t229-wr.log | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rsync public assets and restart wrangler dev
events.input: $ rsync -a /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/public/ /tmp/t229-verify-wt/cloud/public/; cd /tmp/t229-verify-wt/cloud; (nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8911 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8912 --persist-to /tmp/t229-persist > /tmp/t229-wr.log 2>&1 & echo wr=$!); for i in $(seq 1 30); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8911/); [ "$c" != "000" ] && break; perl -e 'select(undef,undef,undef,2)'; done; echo $c; grep -i "error" /tmp/t229-wr.log | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run three probes against fresh stack
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t229-verify-wt; export CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8911 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8912; for p in probe-calendar-feeds probe-zoom-pro probe-tantra-reminders; do echo "== $p"; node app/scripts/$p.mjs > /tmp/t229-$p.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -2 /tmp/t229-$p.log; grep -iE "^\s*(✗|FAIL|not ok)" /tmp/t229-$p.log | head -5; done

events.text: Calendar feeds pass. Zoom-pro and the reminders probe each failed 4 checks, so I'm finding out whether that's caused by T-229 or by running every probe on one stack.

events.input: $ grep -c "^ok\|^  ok\|PASS\|✓" /tmp/t229-probe-calendar-feeds.log; grep -E "^(ok|PASS)" /tmp/t229-probe-calendar-feeds.log | grep -ci "placeholder\|example\|refus\|turned away"; grep -B2 -A2 "FAIL" /tmp/t229-probe-tantra-reminders.log | head -30; grep -n "FAIL  engagement: chat" -B4 /tmp/t229-probe-zoom-pro.log | head
